formatters_by_ft.title: Formatters by filetype
formatters_by_ft.description: Table mapping filetypes to formatters, e.g. { lua = { "stylua" }, javascript = { "prettierd", "prettier" } }

format_on_save.title: Format on save
format_on_save.description: Either false, a table like { timeout_ms = 500, lsp_fallback = true }, or a function.

formatters.title: Formatter configs
formatters.description: Table of formatter definitions, e.g. { prettier = { prepend_args = { "--tab-width", "2" } } }

default_format_on_save.title: Default format on save
default_format_on_save.description: Fallback when no format_on_save given, e.g. { timeout_ms = 500 }
